_about: Public apps in the nightly app scan that aren't deliberately vulnerable, so every codewatch finding in them is a false alarm until read as real (benchmarks/rule_trust.py). All of them are development or learning sets whose false alarms were worked down on purpose (PLAN.md), so these counts flatter the rules: they catch regressions, they don't measure precision. The blind app sets in the README are the untuned measure.
